ABOUT ESOTICA

About Us

A specialist Range Rover and Jaguar service center, with selected luxury vehicle services focused on accurate diagnostics, quality workmanship and follow-up.

OUR APPROACH

Care that starts with diagnosis and continues after delivery.

At Esotica Auto, we focus on understanding the vehicle accurately before work begins, explaining what is needed, carrying out the service carefully, and following up after delivery.

We serve clients through our Fifth Settlement, Third Settlement and Sheikh Zayed locations, with online service booking and spare-parts enquiries available directly through the website.
